rows.question: Show name, country, age for all singers ordered by age from the oldest to the youngest.
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  country ,  age FROM singer ORDER BY age DESC

rows.question: List all song names by singers above the average age.
rows.gold: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)

rows.question: What are the locations and names of all stations with capacity between 5000 and 10000?
rows.gold: SELECT LOCATION ,  name FROM stadium WHERE capacity BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000

rows.question: What is the name and capacity for the stadium with the highest average attendance?
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  capacity FROM stadium ORDER BY average DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What are the names of the stadiums without any concerts?
rows.gold: SELECT name FROM stadium WHERE stadium_id NOT IN (SELECT stadium_id FROM concert)

rows.question: List the maximum weight and type for each type of pet.
rows.gold: SELECT max(weight) ,  petType FROM pets GROUP BY petType

rows.question: How many different types of pet are there?
rows.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT pettype) FROM pets

rows.question: Find the first name of students who have both cat and dog pets .
rows.gold: select t1.fname from student as t1 join has_pet as t2 on t1.stuid  =  t2.stuid join pets as t3 on t3.petid  =  t2.petid where t3.pettype  =  'cat' intersect select t1.fname from student as t1 join has_pet as t2 on t1.stuid  =  t2.stuid join pets as t3 on t3.petid  =  t2.petid where t3.pettype  =  'dog'

rows.question: What major is every student who does not own a cat as a pet, and also how old are they?
rows.gold: SELECT major ,  age FROM student WHERE stuid NOT IN (SELECT T1.stuid FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pettype  =  'cat')

rows.question: Find the first name and age of students who have a pet.
rows.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fname ,  T1.age FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid

rows.question: For each continent, list its id, name, and how many countries it has?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.ContId ,  T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.Continent GROUP BY T1.ContId;

rows.question: What is the number of car models that are produced by each maker and what is the id and full name of each maker?
rows.gold: SELECT Count(*) ,  T2.FullName ,  T2.id FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id GROUP BY T2.id;

rows.question: What is the average edispl of the cars of model volvo?
rows.gold: SELECT avg(T2.edispl) FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T1.Model  =  'volvo';

rows.question: What is the maximum accelerate for all the different cylinders?
rows.gold: SELECT max(Accelerate) ,  Cylinders FROM CARS_DATA GROUP BY Cylinders;

rows.question: What are the different models created by either the car maker General Motors or weighed more than 3500?
rows.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;

rows.question: What is the airport name for airport 'AKO'?
rows.gold: SELECT AirportName FROM AIRPORTS WHERE AirportCode  =  "AKO"

rows.question: How many flights have destination ATO?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS WHERE DestAirport  =  "ATO"

rows.question: Return the number of flights departing from Aberdeen.
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM FLIGHTS AS T1 JOIN AIRPORTS AS T2 ON T1.SourceAirport  =  T2.AirportCode WHERE T2.City  =  "Aberdeen"

rows.question: How many 'United Airlines' flights go to Airport 'ASY'?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM AIRLINES AS T1 JOIN FLIGHTS AS T2 ON T2.Airline  =  T1.uid WHERE T1.Airline  =  "United Airlines" AND T2.DestAirport  =  "ASY"

rows.question: Find the name of airports which do not have any flight in and out.
rows.gold: SELECT AirportName FROM Airports WHERE AirportCode NOT IN (SELECT SourceAirport FROM Flights UNION SELECT DestAirport FROM Flights)

rows.question: Return the name, location and district of all shops in descending order of number of products.
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  LOCATION ,  district FROM shop ORDER BY number_products DESC

rows.question: Which employee received the most awards in evaluations? Give me the employee name.
rows.gold: SELECT t1.name FROM employee AS t1 JOIN evaluation AS t2 ON t1.Employee_ID  =  t2.Employee_ID GROUP BY t2.Employee_ID ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the name of the shops that do not hire any employee.
rows.gold: SELECT name FROM shop WHERE shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM hiring)

rows.question: For each shop, return the number of employees working there and the name of the shop.
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) ,  t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t2.name

rows.question: What is total bonus given in all evaluations?
rows.gold: SELECT sum(bonus) FROM evaluation

rows.question: What are the ids, names, and descriptions for all documents?
rows.gold: SELECT document_id ,  document_name ,  document_description FROM Documents

rows.question: Return the ids of templates that have the code PP or PPT.
rows.gold: SELECT template_id FROM Templates WHERE template_type_code  =  "PP" OR template_type_code  =  "PPT"

rows.question: Return the version numbers and template type codes of templates with a version number greater than 5.
rows.gold: SELECT version_number ,  template_type_code FROM Templates WHERE version_number  >  5

rows.question: What is the document id with 1 to 2 paragraphs?
rows.gold: SELECT document_id FROM Paragraphs GROUP BY document_id HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 2

rows.question: Give the ids of documents that have between one and two paragraphs.
rows.gold: SELECT document_id FROM Paragraphs GROUP BY document_id HAVING count(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 2

rows.question: List the names of teachers in ascending order of age.
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM teacher ORDER BY Age ASC

rows.question: What are the names of the teachers whose hometown is not `` Little Lever Urban District '' ?
rows.gold: select name from teacher where hometown != "little lever urban district"

rows.question: Show the name of teachers aged either 32 or 33?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age  =  32 OR Age  =  33

rows.question: What are the names of the teachers who are aged either 32 or 33?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Age  =  32 OR Age  =  33

rows.question: What are the names of the teachers whose courses have not been arranged?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM teacher WHERE Teacher_id NOT IN (SELECT Teacher_id FROM course_arrange)

rows.question: What is the average age of the visitors whose membership level is not higher than 4?
rows.gold: SELECT avg(age) FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership  <=  4

rows.question: Find the name and membership level of the visitors whose membership level is higher than 4, and sort by their age from old to young.
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  Level_of_membership FROM visitor WHERE Level_of_membership  >  4 ORDER BY age DESC

rows.question: Find the average number of staff working for the museums that were open before 2009.
rows.gold: SELECT avg(num_of_staff) FROM museum WHERE open_year  <  2009

rows.question: What are the opening year and staff number of the museum named Plaza Museum?
rows.gold: SELECT Num_of_Staff ,  Open_Year FROM museum WHERE name  =  'Plaza Museum'

rows.question: What are the average and maximum number of tickets bought in all visits?
rows.gold: SELECT avg(num_of_ticket) ,  max(num_of_ticket) FROM visit

rows.question: Find the year that has the most number of matches.
rows.gold: SELECT YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the name of the winner who has the highest rank points and participated in the Australian Open tourney.
rows.gold: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE tourney_name  =  'Australian Open' ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the name of the winner with the most rank points who participated in the Australian Open tournament?
rows.gold: SELECT winner_name FROM matches WHERE tourney_name  =  'Australian Open' ORDER BY winner_rank_points DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Find the average ranking for each player and their first name.
rows.gold: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

rows.question: Find the number of matches happened in each year.
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) ,  YEAR FROM matches GROUP BY YEAR

rows.question: List the name and tonnage ordered by in descending alphaetical order for the names.
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  tonnage FROM ship ORDER BY name DESC

rows.question: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'

rows.question: What is the ship id and name that caused most total injuries?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.id ,  T2.name FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What are the distinct battle names which are between bulgarian commander 'Kaloyan' and latin commander 'Baldwin I'?
rows.gold: SELECT name FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander  =  'Kaloyan' AND latin_commander  =  'Baldwin I'

rows.question: Show names, results and bulgarian commanders of the battles with no ships lost in the 'English Channel'.
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  RESULT ,  bulgarian_commander FROM battle EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.result ,  T1.bulgarian_commander FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.location  =  'English Channel'

rows.question: What is the first and second line for all addresses?
rows.gold: SELECT line_1 ,  line_2 FROM addresses

rows.question: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.
rows.gold: SELECT T2.department_name ,  T1.department_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Departments AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the name of the course with the most students enrolled?
rows.gold: SELECT  T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What is the last transcript release date?
rows.gold: SELECT transcript_date FROM Transcripts ORDER BY transcript_date DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What are the first names of the students who live in Haiti permanently or have the cell phone number 09700166582 ?
rows.gold: select t1.first_name from students as t1 join addresses as t2 on t1.permanent_address_id  =  t2.address_id where t2.country  =  'haiti' or t1.cell_mobile_number  =  '09700166582'

rows.question: How many TV Channels use the English language?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM TV_Channel WHERE LANGUAGE = "English";

rows.question: What are the languages used by the least number of TV Channels and how many channels use it?
rows.gold: SELECT LANGUAGE ,  count(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY LANGUAGE ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1;

rows.question: For each language, list the number of TV Channels that use it.
rows.gold: SELECT LANGUAGE ,  count(*) FROM TV_Channel GROUP BY LANGUAGE

rows.question: What is the episode for the TV series named "Sky Radio"?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.Episode FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio";

rows.question: Find the package choice and series name of the TV channel that has high definition TV.
rows.gold: SELECT package_option ,  series_name FROM TV_Channel WHERE hight_definition_TV  =  "yes"

rows.question: What is the money rank of the poker player with the highest earnings?
rows.gold: SELECT Money_Rank FROM poker_player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What are the names of poker players?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID

rows.question: What are the names of poker players whose earnings is higher than 300000?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T2.Earnings  >  300000

rows.question: What is the birth date of the poker player with the lowest earnings?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Birth_Date FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T2.Earnings ASC LIMIT 1

rows.question: List the names and birth dates of people in ascending alphabetical order of name.
rows.gold: SELECT Name ,  Birth_Date FROM people ORDER BY Name ASC

rows.question: How many states are there?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM area_code_state

rows.question: What are the maximum and minimum values of area codes?
rows.gold: SELECT max(area_code) ,  min(area_code) FROM area_code_state

rows.question: How many contestants did not get voted?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM contestants WHERE contestant_number NOT IN ( SELECT contestant_number FROM votes )

rows.question: List the area codes in which voters voted both for the contestant 'Tabatha Gehling' and the contestant 'Kelly Clauss'.
rows.gold: SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling' INTERSECT SELECT T3.area_code FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number JOIN area_code_state AS T3 ON T2.state  =  T3.state WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Kelly Clauss'

rows.question: Return the names of the contestants whose names contain the substring 'Al' .
rows.gold: select contestant_name from contestants where contestant_name like "%al%"

rows.question: How many different forms of governments are there in Africa?
rows.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT GovernmentForm) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"

rows.question: Which language is the most popular on the Asian continent?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.Language FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T1.Continent  =  "Asia" GROUP BY T2.Language ORDER BY COUNT (*) DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What are the codes of the countries that do not speak English and whose government forms are not Republic?
rows.gold: SELECT Code FROM country WHERE GovernmentForm != "Republic" EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE  =  "English"

rows.question: Which unique cities are in Asian countries where Chinese is the official language ?
rows.gold: select distinct t3.name from country as t1 join countrylanguage as t2 on t1.code  =  t2.countrycode join city as t3 on t1.code  =  t3.countrycode where t2.isofficial  =  't' and t2.language  =  'chinese' and t1.continent  =  "asia"

rows.question: Find the average life expectancy and total population for each continent where the average life expectancy is shorter than 72?
rows.gold: SELECT sum(Population) ,  avg(LifeExpectancy) ,  Continent FROM country GROUP BY Continent HAVING avg(LifeExpectancy)  <  72

rows.question: Give the names of countries that are in Europe and have a population equal to 80000.
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE continent  =  "Europe" AND Population  =  "80000"

rows.question: What is the name of the conductor who has worked the greatest number of years?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM conductor ORDER BY Year_of_Work DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show the names of conductors and the orchestras they have conducted.
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name ,  T2.Orchestra FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID

rows.question: What are the names of conductors who have conducted orchestras founded after the year 2008?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name FROM conductor AS T1 JOIN orchestra AS T2 ON T1.Conductor_ID  =  T2.Conductor_ID WHERE Year_of_Founded  >  2008

rows.question: Count the number of orchestras that have CD or DVD as their record format.
rows.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orchestra WHERE Major_Record_Format  =  "CD" OR Major_Record_Format  =  "DVD"

rows.question: Show the years in which orchestras that have given more than one performance are founded.
rows.gold: SELECT Year_of_Founded FROM orchestra AS T1 JOIN performance AS T2 ON T1.Orchestra_ID  =  T2.Orchestra_ID GROUP BY T2.Orchestra_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

rows.question: What are the names and grades for each high schooler?
rows.gold: SELECT name ,  grade FROM Highschooler

rows.question: How many high schoolers are there in grade 9 or 10?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM Highschooler WHERE grade  =  9 OR grade  =  10

rows.question: Count the number of friends Kyle has.
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.name  =  "Kyle"

rows.question: What are the names of high schoolers who have likes, and how many likes does each have?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id

rows.question: What is the average grade of students who have friends?
rows.gold: SELECT avg(grade) FROM Highschooler WHERE id IN (SELECT T1.student_id FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id)

rows.question: Find the average age of the dogs who went through treatments.
rows.gold: SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs WHERE dog_id IN ( SELECT dog_id FROM Treatments )

rows.question: What are the first name and last name of the professionals who have done treatment with cost below average?
rows.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 WHERE cost_of_treatment  <  ( SELECT avg(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments )

rows.question: Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.
rows.gold: SELECT T1.name ,  T2.date_of_treatment FROM Dogs AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id  =  T2.dog_id WHERE T1.breed_code  =  ( SELECT breed_code FROM Dogs GROUP BY breed_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )

rows.question: How many dogs have an age below the average?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM Dogs WHERE age  <  ( SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs )

rows.question: What are each professional's first name and description of the treatment they have performed?
rows.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN Treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code

rows.question: What are the names of singers ordered by ascending net worth?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Net_Worth_Millions ASC

rows.question: What are the names of the singers who are not French citizens?
rows.gold: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Citizenship != "France"

rows.question: Show different citizenships and the maximum net worth of singers of each citizenship.
rows.gold: SELECT Citizenship ,  max(Net_Worth_Millions) FROM singer GROUP BY Citizenship

rows.question: What are the names of the singers that have more than one songs?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1

rows.question: For each singer name, what is the total sales for their songs?
rows.gold: SELECT T1.Name ,  sum(T2.Sales) FROM singer AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID  =  T2.Singer_ID GROUP BY T1.Name

rows.question: How many available features are there in total?
rows.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM Other_Available_Features

rows.question: What is the feature type name of feature AirCon?
rows.gold: SELECT T2.feature_type_name FROM Other_Available_Features AS T1 JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS T2 ON T1.feature_type_code  =  T2.feature_type_code WHERE T1.feature_name  =  "AirCon"

rows.question: Show the property type descriptions of properties belonging to that code.
rows.gold: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code

rows.question: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
rows.gold: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
